item.title: How the United States Can Beat China’s A2/AD Network
item.description: China has spent years building a sophisticated A2/AD network covering its First Island Chain. America has likewise spent years planning to defeat it. The post How the United States Can Beat China’s A2/AD Network appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: How the US Air Force’s F-111 Aardvark Changed Air Warfare Forever
item.description: The F-111 Aardvark pioneered a variety of new technological innovations for the US Air Force—and proved that they could be combined to make an excellent strike aircraft. The post How the US Air Force’s F-111 Aardvark Changed Air Warfare Forever appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Russia’s Kalashnikov Concern Is Building an Electric ‘Silent Motorcycle’
item.description: The motorcycle is not really "silent"—but it is far quieter than its existing gas-powered counterparts, allowing Russian scout troops to move quickly with less risk of detection. The post Russia’s Kalashnikov Concern Is Building an Electric ‘Silent Motorcycle’ appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Spain Is Trying to Modernize Its Armada of Frigates
item.description: In spite of budget woes, Spain has announced a plan to overhaul its five aging F-100 frigates to ensure better interoperability with other NATO fleets. The post Spain Is Trying to Modernize Its Armada of Frigates appeared first on The National Interest.

item.description: Europe should consider equity stakes to rebuild industrial and energy resilience, cut dependence on China, and strengthen safeguards across critical industries like rare earth minerals and ports.
